h1: Window cleaning in The Estates of Flintrock
intro: The Estates of Flintrock is a small, gated section of Flintrock with larger lots and larger homes. CleanzATX brings pure water window cleaning here, and you deal with Tyler directly.

sections.h2: What Estates of Flintrock homes are like
paragraphs: Compared with the rest of Flintrock, this section is smaller and more spread out. The lots are larger and the homes follow suit, running from about 2,862 to 5,233 square feet and priced roughly between $900K and $1.9M. Gated entry keeps the streets quiet. The Flintrock HOA governs the section, as it does for the rest of Flintrock.

Larger lots mean more space between homes and more room for landscaping. You see mature trees, flowering beds and long drives. Many homes have deep front porches, large entries and generous back patios. Big rooms usually mean big windows, and often many of them in a row, which is where a careful routine pays off.

sections.h2: What Estates of Flintrock windows deal with
paragraphs: With more landscaping comes more of what grows around it. Tree cover brings spider webs to eaves and window corners, leaf litter to screens, and pollen to everything. Cedar pollen runs December to February, and live oak pollen follows in March and April. Sprinklers watering large lawns throw hard water onto the lower panes, and that leaves white mineral spots that can etch if they sit. Our dual RO, 4 stage pure water system with a DI resin tank gets near 0 TDS, so glass dries clean.

Tall entry glass and transoms are common in homes of this size. Our water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground at The Estates of Flintrock, so we reach them without a ladder against the stone or stucco. Screens are $5, tracks are $5, and hard water removal is $10 per pane.

sections.h2: How we work The Estates of Flintrock
paragraphs: Because this is a small gated section, we bundle visits with nearby Flintrock streets. That keeps the route short and our schedule tight, and lead time for The Estates of Flintrock is usually within two weeks. Send us your address and gate instructions by text. If you have a pool deck or flagstone patio, we clean it by hand so it does not soak. Limestone is never pressure washed here, only soft washed, using our 12V soft wash system. Homes with stone fronts often ask for a house soft wash after window cleaning to match the finish.

For a typical 4,000 sq ft home here, exterior windows come to about $400. Time on site is about 45 to 60 minutes per 1,000 sq ft, so roughly three to four hours outside, and about 30 minutes per 1,000 sq ft for the inside. Minimum job is $200.

Limestone is never pressure washed. We use a 12V soft wash system that cleans stone, stucco and roofs gently. House soft wash in The Estates of Flintrock starts at $0.20 per sq ft with a $400 minimum.
Yes. Text us your address and your gate process, and we will check in when we arrive.
